fields.summary_ko.0: Texas Instruments (TXN) Q3 revenue increased 28% to $6.06 billion, EPS jumped 77% to $2.62, with data center revenue surging 95%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Lam Research (LRCX) benefits from semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply to industry capacity expansion investments, while TXN is growing through analog and embedded chip demand recovery and manufacturing capacity expansion.
fields.summary_ko.2: TXN's 300mm wafer strategy and 12-month operating cash flow of $9.9 billion (43% increase) are expected to support cost reduction and long-term profitability improvement.
